mechanism: Amikacin, an aminoglycoside antibiotic, can cause ototoxicity and nephrotoxicity which may potentiate galantamine's cholinergic effects on the vestibular system and impair renal clearance of galantamine.
action: Monitor renal function, auditory function, and galantamine efficacy; adjust galantamine dose if renal impairment develops; consider alternative antibiotics if possible.
